spine: 1. Log 的自然存法是一行一筆 row，但 VictoriaLogs 反過來把每個 field 各自存成一欄、各自壓縮，查詢只碰用到的欄——這是整篇的核心反直覺。
2. 磁碟上的層級是 partition（一天一目錄）→ part（一個目錄含多檔）→ block（單一 stream 的 rows，上限約 2 MiB）；每一層都是一個可被跳過的單位。
3. part 目錄裡每個檔案各司其職：metadata.json 決定要不要打開整個 part、timestamps.bin 是 _time 專欄、values.binN/bloom.binN 是分 shard 的值與布隆、column_names/idxs 做欄名與 shard 的對映、index/metaindex 做 block header 索引。
4. 欄式之所以壓得好，是因為同一欄的值同型、同 stream 的相鄰值高度重複；dictionary、uint16、timestamp delta、IP 等各型各自用最合適的編碼——5.6 GiB 原始壓到 513 MiB。
5. bloom filter 是每個 block-column 的詞彙指紋，回答只有『definitely not』與『maybe』兩種，每個 unique token 約 2 bytes，讓關鍵字查詢能在讀值之前先跳掉整個 block。
6. 查詢快的本質是『每一層都跳過大塊只讀小塊』：parts 按時間、blocks 按 stream 與時間、columns 按 query 的欄、keywords 按 bloom——這也是 retention 用刪整天目錄就能完成的原因。
7. 給工程師的決策：stream fields 要穩定且低基數（host/app/pod/container），時間範圍越窄查詢越便宜；欄式對高基數 log 的取捨是寫入時要拆欄與建 bloom，換查詢時的精準掃描。

perspective.mechanism: 把 log 以 columnar layout 落盤：每個 field 自成一欄、各自壓縮，搭配 partition/part/block 三層可跳過單位與每個 block-column 的 bloom filter，使查詢只觸碰真正需要的 bytes。
perspective.tradeoff: 欄式把成本從查詢時搬到寫入與儲存時（拆欄、建 bloom、維護多檔索引），換來高基數 log 的高壓縮比與精準掃描；代價是 stream fields 必須低基數、否則 block 切割與 bloom 成本失控。
perspective.reader_use: 台灣工程師若在自架 observability，可據此設定 _stream_fields 為穩定低基數欄位、用窄時間範圍與 | fields 限制讀取量，並理解 retention 為何是刪整天目錄而非逐筆刪。

notes.quote: VictoriaLogs only has to touch the columns a request actually uses, instead of reading every field of every row.
notes.interpretation: 欄式的核心好處：查詢只讀用到的欄。

notes.quote: a partition holds exactly one calendar day of logs (in UTC).
notes.interpretation: partition 以 UTC 日為單位。

notes.quote: Retention is achieved by deleting whole day directories.
notes.interpretation: retention 是刪整天目錄。

notes.quote: A block holds rows from a single stream, and a part contains many blocks.
notes.interpretation: block 只裝單一 stream 的 rows；part 裝很多 block。

notes.quote: A block is capped at roughly 2 MiB of uncompressed data (it can stretch to almost 4 MiB when parts are combined).
notes.interpretation: block 未壓縮約上限 2 MiB，合併 part 時可拉到近 4 MiB。

notes.quote: set `_stream_fields=pod,container`, and all logs with the same pod and container form one stream.
notes.interpretation: stream 由 _stream_fields 定義。

notes.quote: keep stream fields stable and low-cardinality, meaning they should have only a handful of distinct values, such as `host`, `app`, `pod`, or `container`
notes.interpretation: stream fields 要穩定且低基數。

notes.quote: every part has exactly one `metadata.json`, and it is human-readable, so VictoriaLogs can decide in an instant whether the part is even worth opening
notes.interpretation: metadata.json 用來秒判要不要打開 part。

notes.quote: `timestamps.bin` is the dedicated column that holds the `_time` of every row.
notes.interpretation: timestamps.bin 是 _time 專欄。

notes.quote: Each block encodes its values for a field into one blob, a single continuous chunk of bytes, and appends it to that field's shard file.
notes.interpretation: 每 block 把一個 field 的值編成連續 blob append 到 shard 檔。

notes.quote: A part can have up to 128 shards (`values.bin0` through `values.bin127`, and the matching `bloom.bin0` through `bloom.bin127`).
notes.interpretation: 一個 part 最多 128 shard。

notes.quote: messages are usually the largest and most-read field, so giving them their own file lets VictoriaLogs read and decode them independently from the smaller fields.
notes.interpretation: _msg 給專屬檔，獨立於小 field 讀解。

notes.quote: VictoriaLogs gives every distinct field name in a part a short numeric column ID. `column_names.bin` is where the mapping lives.
notes.interpretation: field name 到 column ID 對映存 column_names.bin。

notes.quote: For every distinct field name in the part, VictoriaLogs picks a shard number and records that 'column to shard' mapping.
notes.interpretation: column_idxs.bin 記 field name 對 shard。

notes.quote: A column header is the small record that describes one field inside one block
notes.interpretation: column header 描述某 block 內某 field。

notes.quote: `index.bin` is where all of a part's block headers live
notes.interpretation: index.bin 存 part 的 block headers。

notes.quote: A bloom filter is a tiny fingerprint of all the words in one block's column.
notes.interpretation: bloom 是某 block 某欄全部詞的小指紋。

notes.quote: The answer is one of two: **"definitely not"** (with certainty) or **"maybe"**.
notes.interpretation: bloom 只回確定沒有／可能有。

notes.quote: VictoriaLogs takes one column of a block, say the `_msg` field, and breaks every value in it into tokens, where a token is a run of letters, digits, or underscores.
notes.interpretation: tokenize：每個值切成 token。

notes.quote: Each unique token costs only about 2 bytes, so the size is easy to reason about: a block-column with 1,000 unique words needs roughly 2 KB of bloom, and one with 20,000 unique tokens about 40 KB.
notes.interpretation: 每 unique token 約 2 bytes；1,000 詞約 2 KB、20,000 約 40 KB。

notes.quote: When you later search for `error`, VictoriaLogs splits your query into tokens the same way and asks the bloom 'are these tokens here?'.
notes.interpretation: 查詢也切 token，問 bloom。

notes.quote: so when you search for `error`, VictoriaLogs asks each block's bloom filter first, skips every block that answers 'definitely not', and only then reads the actual values from the few blocks that answered 'maybe'.
notes.interpretation: 先問 bloom 跳掉 definitely not，只讀 maybe 的 block。

notes.quote: When you ask for one stream over the last hour, VictoriaLogs jumps straight to that stream's blocks and, using each block header's min and max timestamp, skips any block whose time range cannot overlap your window.
notes.interpretation: 用 block header 的 min/max timestamp 跳掉時間不重疊的 block。

notes.quote: Adding `| fields ...` (or its alias `| keep ...`) tells VictoriaLogs to read only the columns you name and skip the rest.
notes.interpretation: | fields/| keep 只讀指名的欄。

notes.quote: Queries are fast because VictoriaLogs skips work at every level: whole parts by time range, blocks by stream and time, columns by which fields you query, and keywords by bloom filter.
notes.interpretation: 四層跳過：parts/blocks/columns/keywords。

notes.quote: take about 513 MiB on disk (`"CompressedSizeBytes": 537919490`, from roughly 5.6 GiB of raw logs, so compression is doing real work here)
notes.interpretation: 約 5.6 GiB 壓到 513 MiB。

notes.quote: the values are small whole numbers (the `uint16` type)
notes.interpretation: 小整數用 uint16。

notes.quote: A column of repeated words is stored as a small dictionary plus references to it.
notes.interpretation: 重複詞多的欄用 dictionary 加引用。

notes.quote: the value type (string, dictionary, number, timestamp, IP, and so on), which tells VictoriaLogs how to read the bytes
notes.interpretation: value type 告訴怎麼讀 bytes。

notes.quote: Every file in a part exists for one reason: to read something small and skip something large.
notes.interpretation: part 裡每個檔案的理由：讀小跳大。

notes.quote: "RowsCount": 4240299
notes.interpretation: 範例 RowsCount 4,240,299。

notes.quote: "BlocksCount": 1915
notes.interpretation: 範例 BlocksCount 1,915。

notes.quote: When every value in a column has the same shape or type, it compresses extremely well.
notes.interpretation: 同欄同型壓得極好。

notes.quote: Logs in the same stream look very similar to one another, so neighboring values in a column repeat a lot and squeeze down even further.
notes.interpretation: 同 stream 相鄰值重複多，再被壓小。

notes.quote: `columns_header_index.bin` removes that walk. For each block, it stores a tiny lookup table mapping column IDs to the exact byte offset of each column's header within the blob.
notes.interpretation: columns_header_index.bin 為每 block 存 column ID 到 header offset 的查表。

notes.quote: VictoriaLogs scans the in-memory `metaindex.bin`, where each record is just a stream range, a time range, and a link into `index.bin`.
notes.interpretation: metaindex.bin 在記憶體掃描，每筆是 stream range + time range + 連結。
